==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged, but with lower priority than skills with greater/additional effect(s).

==Notes==
* With a high enough attribute rank in [[Strength]], also consider [[Body Blow]], which costs less adrenaline and can inflict Deep Wound.

== Trivia ==
* [[Executioner]]s do not use Executioner's Strike.
